programme.title: Ficheiros Alienígenas Reabertos T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O físico Paul Bennewitz estava convicto de que localizara um laboratório subterrâneo secreto de homens e extraterrestres em Dulce, Novo México, perto de Los Alamos.

programme.title: Ficheiros Alienígenas Reabertos T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um OVNI detetado num radar militar aterrou perto de bases cruciais da NATO. Por volta das 3h da manhã de 26 de dezembro, uma patrulha de segurança próximo da RAF Woodbridge avistou luzes descendentes.

programme.title: Ficheiros Alienígenas Reabertos T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Objetos silenciosos a planar ou a pairar, foram avistados por milhares de pessoas e investigados por cientistas universitários e autoridades oficiais… que nunca conseguiram explicá-los.

programme.title: Fugas Históricas Com Morgan Freeman T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No campo de Sobibor, na Polónia, um pequeno grupo de judeus, arquitetou uma fuga coletiva que salvaria a vida a muitos deles, vindo a dar conhecimento do Holocausto ao resto do mundo.

programme.title: Fugas Históricas Com Morgan Freeman T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Depois de muitos anos e de várias tentativas, René Belbenoît conseguiu fugir de uma colónia penal na Guiana Francesa. A sua história inspiraria diversos filmes de Hollywood.

programme.title: Fugas Históricas Com Morgan Freeman T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quawntay Adams é apanhado numa grande apreensão de marijuana e condenado a prisão. No entanto, ao saber que vai ser pai, decide evadir-se da sua cela de segurança máxima.

programme.title: A Ascensão Dos Ditadores T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Os ditadores são carismáticos, narcisistas e sádicos. Mas, acima de tudo, anseiam pelo poder. Permanecer no poder depois de se lá chegar requer um misto de negociação, coação e força.

programme.title: A Ascensão Dos Ditadores T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O poder absoluto é viciante. Um ditador não só quer mantê-lo para sempre, como é tentado a estendê-lo além-fronteiras, o que implica agressão militar e a morte de um grande número de soldados e civis.

programme.title: A Ascensão Dos Ditadores T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: As ditaduras são quase universalmente insustentáveis. A sede de poder e riqueza de um tirano conduz invariavelmente a cada vez mais opressão, o que dilacera uma nação.

programme.title: O Médico-Assassino Na Paris Nazi
programme.desc: Este documentário revela a chocante história do Dr. Marcel Petiot, um respeitado médico rural francês que foi também um psicopata calculista e violento.

programme.title: Alienígenas T14 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Se os extraterrestres vieram à Terra, vindos de locais a anos-luz de distância, será que têm capacidade de dominar tanto o tempo como o espaço?.

programme.title: Alienígenas T14 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Giorgio volta a recordar algumas das estruturas mais incríveis que visitaram no mundo inteiro. Estruturas essas que, na opinião de Giorgio, fornecem provas inegáveis de um contacto extraterrestre.

programme.title: Os Caçadores De Mistérios T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Explore connosco a história da misteriosa ilha de Rapa Nui. Qual o significado e a origem das suas estátuas em pedra? A sua existência é um prodígio do engenho humano.

programme.title: Os Caçadores De Mistérios T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Têm-lhe atribuído a previsão certeira de eventos cruciais da História, da Revolução Francesa aos ataques terroristas do 11 de Setembro e até ao coronavírus. Como conseguiu prever tantas catástrofes?.

programme.title: As Grandes Marcas Que Mudaram O Mundo T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Pais fundadores das maiores lojas de revenda do mundo defrontam-se para ser os primeiros a inovar, construir e revolucionar o ramo. Sam Walton, erguerá o maior império da venda a retalho do mundo.

programme.title: As Grandes Marcas Que Mudaram O Mundo T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Há 100 anos, a expedição de encomendas era lenta, e o envio de um dia para o outro era impossível, até dois irmãos de Seattle arriscarem tudo na reinvenção do ramo.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T23 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Quando chega à loja um sobretudo outrora do suspeito de assassinar JFK, serão as negociações um passeio no parque, ou irá Rick perder a sua oportunidade de ficar com um artigo histórico?.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T23 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Rick e Chum recebem um raro par de ténis da Puma de 1968. Mas irá o exorbitante preço pedido deixá-los fora da corrida, ou conseguirão chegar à sua meta?.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T23 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Rick e Chum recebem um pacote relativamente genial contendo cartas assinadas por Albert Einstein. A seguir, Chum e Corey deliciam-se com replicas do elmo e martelo do Thor.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T23 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Chum dá tudo, quando chega à loja uma luva de golfe autografada por Jack Nicklaus. Entretanto, Corey está de olho num helicóptero Tomahawk dos GI Joes de brincar.

programme.desc: Em 1939, a Alemanha e a URSS aliavam-se secretamente, permitindo que Hitler invade a Polónia e desencadeasse uma guerra brutal que mergulhou a Europa num conflito global.

programme.title: II Guerra Mundial Com Tom Hanks T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Depois de tomar a Polónia, Hitler planeia um ataque à França. A Grã-Bretanha evacua Dunquerque enquanto a Alemanha bombardeia o Reino Unido. Roosevelt reforça o apoio dos EUA.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Thandi and Lula are two-month-old wild dog pups ? the only females in a litter of six. Lula loves to rough and tumble with her brothers, while Thandi is more of a loner, often exploring away from the others.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: The Nsefu Pride of lions lives on the banks of the Luangwa River in Zambia. Experienced lionesses bring up a family of youngsters. Seven new cubs are born into the wet season - not the easiest time.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Two big male lions, twin brothers with a powerful bond, have ruled the Nsefu Pride for three years - they're fathers to all the young, and protectors of their territory.

programme.title: Land Of The Iberian Lynx T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory. .

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm. .

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets: Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won’t move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, ‘leave your bubble at your peril’. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called 'boss crocs,” are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction.

programme.title: Land Of The Iberian Lynx T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Land Of The Iberian Lynx T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Spring rains bring new opportunities and hope to the land of the Iberian lynx. But for the female lynxes of the valley, it is always a challenge to raise their cubs. The series follows the lynxes in their struggle for survival, from the thrill of the hunt to the tender moments of parenting, and also witnesses their coexistence with other animals like majestic golden eagles or powerful deer.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tigers cool off in it, fight over it and lie in wait for prey on its edges. Elephants, rhinos and buffalo guzzle it, submerge in it, depend on it. The great hornbill and lion tailed macaques depends on it too, to create forests big enough to sustain them. Hokkaido's brow bears wouldn't survive without it. Whether it comes from the monsoon, from Himalayan meltwater, the tides or snow, ever animal in Asia has a story to tell about water.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Snow leopards stalk the highest living sheep on earth, while Japanese macaques relax in volcanic hot springs. Giant Pandas spend half their day eating woody grass, while their relatives the Tibetan brown bear must work hard to dig up a rabbit-like pika from burrows.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: On this episode of The Incredible Dr. Pol, Doc dodges kicks from a choking mare, Dr. Brenda hoofs it to a limping cow, and Dr. Lisa treats a wobbly steer. At the clinic, the docs face a deluge of dogs: a Chihuahua with a broken leg, a pregnant pooch that looks ready to burst, and a Doberman with mysterious bumps on his face. From mules to mutts, the vets have it covered.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T19 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: The vets at PVS tackle a range of summertime sores, from a guinea pig with an abscess, to a reindeer with an unusual scab. A German Shepherd with severe lacerations and a puppy with an eye injury needs Dr. Nicole’s expertise. Dr. Pol works his magic on a down cow and a cat that was hit by a car. Ten adorable puppies get health checks and a mini horse is in urgent need of help.

programme.title: Kalahari – Africa's Underground Desert - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit. They deploy adaptive strategies and surprising maneuvers to survive against all odds.

programme.desc: Big Cat Wars will showcase an incredibly unique stock footage sequence of a moment when a predator on predator conflict turns deadly. The clip of lion vs cheetah is a nail biting moment that will shock, but in the end will shed new light on the mysterious relationship between these extraordinary big cats and their life-and-death struggle for survival.

programme.title: Venom Files - Anatomy Of A Snake Bite - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Millions are bitten by snakes each year, yet their venom evolved for hunting, not harming humans. Explore the fascinating and deadly adaptations of the king cobra, black mamba, inland taipan, puff adder, saw-scaled viper, Mozambique spitting cobra and the fearsome boomslang. Journey from India's vibrant villages to Africa’s wild bush and Australia’s outback to witness how venom paralyzes, digests and protects.
